message.name: SCKY_IMU_STATUS
message.description: Detection and health state for one physical IMU.
message.field: Zero-based physical IMU index; matches HIGHRES_IMU.id.
1 when a supported device answered WHO_AM_I during boot.
1 when the device is usable by the estimator.

message.name: SCKY_ESC_TELEM
message.description: Per-motor ESC telemetry (BLHeli32 / KISS) plus aggregate consumption and analog current. crc_extra=91.
message.field: Consumption reported by the most recent ESC record.
Aggregate pack current (sum of per-motor current).
Mechanical RPM per motor (eRPM / pole pairs).
ESC input voltage per motor, hundredths of a volt.
ESC current per motor, hundredths of an amp.
ESC error / desync count per motor.

message.name: SCKY_ESC_CONFIG
message.description: Live analog-PWM ESC configuration echoed by the FC. crc_extra=33.
message.field: PWM carrier frequency; applied at boot.
Motor order: logical motor i drives physical output output_map[i] (0..3 = PA0..PA3).

message.name: SCKY_ESC_SET
message.description: Write the live analog-PWM ESC configuration (ground station -> FC). Same fields as SCKY_ESC_CONFIG. crc_extra=154.
message.field: PWM carrier frequency; applied at boot.
Motor order: logical motor i drives physical output output_map[i] (0..3 = PA0..PA3).

message.name: SCKY_ESC_CMD
message.description: One-shot ESC action (ground station -> FC). crc_extra=106.
message.field: Action: 1 = start throttle-range calibration, 2 = stop calibration, 3 = stop all.
